objective: Ask whether an advertised WooCommerce integration can begin with a separately paid, isolated signing diagnostic, without accepting live recharge handling.

source_need.title: Director
source_need.budget: $500-$1500 advertised; currency unspecified, no price quoted or agreed
source_need.location: Central Coast, Australia; remote contractor eligibility unconfirmed
source_need.scope: The full listing requests WooCommerce/BIGO API authentication and RSA-signing repair, IP checks, post-payment recharge fulfillment, retries, logging and vendor liaison.
source_need.application_invitation: The listing explicitly invites applications by email.
source_need.qualification_gap: Its claimed reseller authorization and the availability of a non-billable signature test are not independently verified.

fit.supported_now: First-party WordPress publishing work and an independently merged explicit client-credentials endpoint contribution.
not_claimed: Proven WooCommerce payment automation or RSA integration experience
Verified reseller authorization, API specifications or a safe free test endpoint
Ability to fulfill the complete production brief for its advertised budget

application.method: One individually reviewed email responding to the explicit application invitation.
application.delivery_evidence: The business sender, advertised recipient, subject and complete body were reviewed before one Send action and matched in Sent afterward. This is sender-side evidence, not recipient acknowledgement.
application.development_method_disclosed: AI-assisted development with code review and tests
application.follow_up_policy: Review inbound only; no additional message without a relevant reply.

scope_gate: Confirm project availability and remote eligibility
Confirm willingness to buy a separate diagnostic before quoting; it does not fulfill the advertised implementation
Establish the employer's authorization and rights-cleared API documentation
Verify an isolated staging copy and non-billable test route before handling secrets or running requests
Agree bounded checks, deliverables, currency, price, timeline, revisions and data handling before work
No live recharges, production order handling, key transfer or direct vendor-support obligation through this inquiry
